=INSERT INTO surveys (
  customer_phone,
  customer_name,
  context_summary,
  conversation_transcript,
  status
) VALUES (
  '{{ $node['Parse Agent 3 Response'].json.customer_phone }}',
  '{{ $node['Parse Agent 3 Response'].json.customer_name }}',
  '{{ $node['Parse Agent 3 Response'].json.analysis.summary }}',
  '[{"role": "assistant", "content": {{ $node['Parse Agent 3 Response'].json.message.toJsonString() }}}]'::jsonb,
  'active'
)

=UPDATE surveys SET 
  conversation_transcript = '{{ $json.conversation_transcript }}'::jsonb,
  satisfaction_score = {{ $json.satisfaction_score || 'NULL' }},
  main_feedback = {{ $json.main_feedback ? "'" + $json.main_feedback + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  sentiment = {{ $json.sentiment ? "'" + $json.sentiment + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  status = '{{ $json.status }}',
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = {{ $json.survey_id }}
